decisions.reason: These reader and writer plug-ins build directly on the firm's core geospatial data-integration know-how, and their visible product-line status together with in-house R&D makes continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.

The building data digital twin service fits the firm's geospatial and enterprise-integration capabilities well enough that management is likely to keep learning from projects and improve the offer rather than exit quickly.

Authentication and identity delegation remains more adjacent than core GIS functionality and the earlier withdrawal of Product E raises caution, but it is still close enough to the firm's software-integration base to justify continued retention for now.

An open GIS application development framework is a strategically central product for a firm with strong software, standards, and consulting competencies, so absorptive capacity strongly favors keeping it on the market.

The geodata business process consulting workshop draws on the firm's established consulting and training strengths, and its close fit with customer processes makes adaptation easier than discontinuation.
